chapter: Carnegie Hall, nicknames and later career
title: Katie Crippen's act, again
summary: Basie says he does not remember Katie Crippen at all and Kuehl plans to ask May.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: He just announced himself one day; is that it? 'Hello, I'm your road manager.' Okay. Did you ever find out, by the way -- did you ever
remember Katie Crippen and her Jazz Hounds?
Yeah, but remember that you said that you weren't sure -- it was like Jazz Hounds, but the name of her act was not Jazz Hounds.
I don't know what -- I don't remember Katie Crippen at all.
I'll ask her. We'll try to bring May into the archives. Okay? What do you want me to ask you?
